name: change-asked-lighter-fortnight
why: A change he asks for, stated with its reason and its length: 'make my sessions lighter for the next two weeks'. That is the volume change, offered with Apply (ask-cant-face-it is the case where he did NOT ask, and asking comes first there). The 18 Nov run had the coach ANNOUNCE a volume drop with no card; this is the case where the card is the right answer.
messages: work is mental for the next two weeks, can you make my sessions lighter until it calms down?
